fluids.specification: Genuine NISSAN Motor Oil 0W-20 SP (or equivalent). If not available, synthetic 0W-20 GF-6A SP motor oil may be used. Must meet API or ILSAC certification.
fluids.capacity: 4-3/8 qt with oil filter change; 4 qt without oil filter change

fluids.specification: Pre-diluted Genuine NISSAN Long Life Antifreeze/Coolant (blue) or equivalent. 50% antifreeze / 50% water mixture providing protection to -34°F (-37°C).

extraction_caveats: 1. The schedule pages (633–644) are presented as milestone-based columns (every 5,000 miles / 6 months), not as a simple repeat-interval table; intervals were inferred by identifying the recurring pattern across milestones. 2. Engine oil replacement appears at 20k, 30k, 40k, 50k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 100k, 110k, 120k miles — approximately every 10,000 miles / 12 months, triggered by the oil life monitor indicator. 3. The schedule begins at page 612 (table of contents references '2.0L 4 cylinder (MR20DD engine model)' starting at p.612) but pages 611–612 were not provided; the earliest milestone page provided is 633 (15,000 miles). 4. Brake fluid replacement under standard schedule appears at 20k, 40k, 60k, 80k, 100k, 120k miles (every 20,000 miles). Under severe schedule it appears at every 5,000-mile interval. 5. Fuel filter is noted as 'periodic maintenance not required (in-tank type filter)' — not captured as a maintenance item. 6. Engine valve clearance is marked with * and states 'Inspect only if valve noise increases' — not a scheduled interval item. 7. Fuel lines/connections inspection is described in the explanation section but no explicit mileage interval was visible in the provided pages. 8. Page 628 fluid capacity table was partially provided; brake fluid capacity was not listed on the provided pages. 9. The 'Intelligent Key battery' appears as both an inspect item (15k miles) and a replace item (30k-mile cadence); both are captured. 10. CVT fluid inspection appears at many intervals; replacement is explicitly called out at 60k and 120k miles in the standard schedule.
